notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
